people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: This is eternal life, that they should know you, the only true God, and him whom you sent, Jesus Christ.
translations.bsb: Now this is eternal life, that they may know You, the only true God, and Jesus Christ, whom You have sent.
translations.kjv: And this is life eternal, that they might know thee the only true God, and Jesus Christ, whom thou hast sent.
translations.asv: And this is life eternal, that they should know thee the only true God, and him whom thou didst send, even Jesus Christ.
